## Data tables

Add `.data-table` to a captioned table for a dark header, banded rows, and a frame. Add `.row-headers` when the first column names each row.

| Test | Capacity | Requests | Expected | Result |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Ordinary | 10 | 4, 3 | Both booked | Pass |
| Exact fit | 10 | 4, 6 | Both booked | Fail |
| Over capacity | 10 | 4, 7 | Second rejected | Pass |
| Empty | 10 | none | Nothing booked | Pass |

: Planned tests for a 10-seat minibus {#tbl-minibus-tests .data-table .row-headers}

```markdown
: Planned tests for a 10-seat minibus {#tbl-minibus-tests .data-table .row-headers}
```

## Trace tables

A `.trace-table` keeps its first column visible while the rest scrolls, so each step stays next to its state.

| Step | Request | Condition | Booked before | Booked after | Seats left | Decision | Note |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| 1 | 4 | 0 + 4 < 10 | 0 | 4 | 6 | Book | Ordinary request |
| 2 | 7 | 4 + 7 < 10 | 4 | 4 | 6 | Reject | Would exceed capacity |
| 3 | 3 | 4 + 3 < 10 | 4 | 7 | 3 | Book | Fits with room to spare |

: Trace of the minibus algorithm for requests of 4, 7, and 3 seats {#tbl-minibus-trace .data-table .trace-table .row-headers}

## Great Tables

Output from the Great Tables package is framed automatically. Grids with a stub column give it room and keep it in view on small screens.

::: {#tbl-loan-decision}

```{=html}
<div id="loan-decision">
<table class="gt_table" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th class="gt_col_heading gt_left">Rule</th>
      <th class="gt_col_heading gt_center">R1</th>
      <th class="gt_col_heading gt_center">R2</th>
      <th class="gt_col_heading gt_center">R3</th>
      <th class="gt_col_heading gt_center">R4</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><th colspan="5" class="gt_group_heading">Conditions</th></tr>
    <tr><th class="gt_row gt_left gt_stub">Is a member</th><td class="gt_row gt_center">Y</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">Y</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">Y</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">N</td></tr>
    <tr><th class="gt_row gt_left gt_stub">Has overdue items</th><td class="gt_row gt_center">N</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">N</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">Y</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">–</td></tr>
    <tr><th class="gt_row gt_left gt_stub">Under the loan limit</th><td class="gt_row gt_center">Y</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">N</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">–</td><td class="gt_row gt_center">–</td></tr>
    <tr><th colspan="5" class="gt_group_heading">Actions</th></tr>
    <tr><th class="gt_row gt_left gt_stub">Lend the book</th><td class="gt_row gt_center" style="background-color: #e8f5ee;">✓</td><td class="gt_row gt_center"></td><td class="gt_row gt_center"></td><td class="gt_row gt_center"></td></tr>
    <tr><th class="gt_row gt_left gt_stub">Refuse the loan</th><td class="gt_row gt_center"></td><td class="gt_row gt_center" style="background-color: #e8f5ee;">✓</td><td class="gt_row gt_center" style="background-color: #e8f5ee;">✓</td><td class="gt_row gt_center" style="background-color: #e8f5ee;">✓</td></tr>
  </tbody>
  <tfoot class="gt_sourcenotes">
    <tr><td class="gt_sourcenote" colspan="5">Y means yes, N means no, and a dash means the condition does not matter.</td></tr>
  </tfoot>
</table>
</div>
```

## Pseudocode

A fenced block with the `.pseudocode` class becomes a numbered terminal. Readers can link to a line.

```{.pseudocode}
booked ← 0
for each request in requests
    if booked + request ≤ capacity then
        booked ← booked + request
        record "book"
    else
        record "reject"
    end if
end for
return booked
```

````markdown
```{.pseudocode}
booked ← 0
...
```
````

## Flowcharts

Mermaid diagrams keep their natural size and scroll when wider than the column. Lucid adds an SVG title and description taken from the caption.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-minibus-flow
%%| fig-cap: "Decision flow for one booking request"
flowchart TD
  A([Start]) --> B[/Read capacity, booked, and request/]
  B --> C{booked + request ≤ capacity?}
  C -- yes --> D[Add request to booked]
  C -- no --> E[Reject request]
  D --> F([End])
  E --> F
```

## Exercises and solutions

A label inside a heading gets a copy-reference button. A callout titled `Solution [-@exr-id]` is retitled with the exercise identifier.

### [E2.3]{.exercise-label data-exercise-id="E2.3"} Trace a running total {.exercise-heading}

::: {#exr-running-total data-exercise-id="E2.3"}
Trace `running_total([4, 7, 3])` and record `total` after each iteration.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Solution [-@exr-running-total]"}
After each iteration `total` holds 4, 11, and 14, so the function returns `[4, 11, 14]`.
:::
